GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.

7. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   B. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.

8. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   B. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Fishing as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   D. Treat Lakes as rumours only.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

11. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   B. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   C. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
